صَحِيفٌ [appears from what here follows, to be syn. with ↓ صَحِيفَةٌ , or rather it is a coll. gen. n. of which the latter is the n. un.:] (tropical:) The surface of the ground or earth; (O, K, TA;) as being likened to the thing [i. e. paper or skin] that is written upon. (TA.) ―
-b2- See also the next paragraph.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
